reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ravindra Vankadara
reviewSamples.text: Tried the vegetarian food at Helo India Food Truck, and it was excellent. The flavors were authentic, fresh, and perfectly balanced. The environment around the truck was clean and welcoming, which made the experience even better. Definitely a great spot for tasty vegetarian Indian food.
